# UI/Component

## Headers

- [Component.h](Component.h): A lightweight UI element: bounds, children, paint, and mouse events. (declares `Component`)
- [GPUComponent.h](GPUComponent.h): Custom GPU rendering inside a component tree: a GPUView's render(Frame&), drawn into a texture of the component's own and composited by the host in its frame like any other drawing - clipped by its ancestors, under and over its siblings, faded and transformed through its layer. (declares `GPUComponent`)
- [KeyEvent.h](KeyEvent.h): A key event as the component receiving it sees it, which is exactly as the native view saw it. (declares `KeyEvent`, `ModifierKeys`)
- [MouseEvent.h](MouseEvent.h): A mouse event as the component receiving it sees it. (declares `MouseEvent`)
- [SafePointer.h](SafePointer.h): declares `SafePointer`
